name: Aisyah binti Rahman
bio:
Aisyah's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While pursuing her electrical engineering degree at Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, a guest lecture by a Formula 1 engineer ignited a passion she never knew she possessed. After graduating, she honed her skills at a local automotive company before landing a role with a Malaysian racing team competing in regional championships. Her dedication and problem-solving abilities quickly earned her recognition. 

Aisyah is known for her methodical approach to electronics, combined with an uncanny ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues quickly. She excels in data analysis and utilizes it to optimize vehicle performance. Her adaptability and willingness to experiment with new technologies make her a valuable asset to any team. She's particularly keen on developing more sustainable energy recovery systems in karting.

physical.hairStyle: neatly tied back in a practical low bun
physical.description: Aisyah has a warm smile and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of humming quietly while concentrating on complex problems.
Insists on starting the day with a strong cup of kopi tarik.
